questions.stem: A box plot displays five key values. Which of the following is NOT one of them?
questions.explanation: A box plot shows the minimum, lower quartile ($Q_1$), median ($Q_2$), upper quartile ($Q_3$), and maximum. The mean is not shown on a standard box plot.

questions.stem: A box plot has $Q_1 = 15$, median $= 22$, and $Q_3 = 35$. What is the IQR?
